priority.description: Optional. The priority level of the vulnerability data. Ex: "P1".

technologies.description: Required. All technologies affected by the vulnerability. Ex: "Apache Struts".

disclosureTime.description: Optional. The disclosure time of the vulnerability.

exploitationConsequences.description: Optional. List of exploitation consequences for the vulnerability.

epssScore.description: Optional. The EPSS score, representing the probability of exploitation. Example: 0.87.

productFixes.description: Optional. List of product fixes for the vulnerability.

exploitationVectors.description: Optional. List of exploitation vectors for the vulnerability.

enumDescriptions: Unspecified risk rating. This is the default value when the risk rating is not set.
The vulnerability has been assessed, but a specific risk rating could not be determined or assigned.
riskRating.description: Required. The risk rating of the vulnerability.

associations.description: Optional. Associated threat actors, malware, etc. This is embedded as a snapshot because the details of the association at the time of the vulnerability match are important for context and reporting.

publiclyAvailableExploit.description: Output only. Whether a publicly available exploit exists.

cveId.description: Required. The CVE ID of the vulnerability. Ex: "CVE-2025-9876". See https://www.cve.org/ for more information.

cvss3Score.description: Required. The CVSS score of the vulnerability. Evaluates to CVSS v3 when available with a fallback to v2 and v4. Example: 6.4.

matchedTechnologies.description: Optional. The specific technologies from the configured watchlist that triggered the match. Ex: "Apache Struts".

description.description: Required. A description of the vulnerability.

VulnerabilityMatch.description: Contains details about a vulnerability match.

severity.description: Required. The severity of the IAB finding. This indicates the potential impact of the threat.
